[[Jormungand]] is a [[Wurm]] [[boss]] that [[spawn]]s in the [[Far Shiverpeaks]].

== Locations ==

This NPC randomly spawns on rare occasions in these locations (see [[Talk:Jormungand|the discussion page]] for further details):

* [[Far Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Bjora Marches}} (one known location)
** {{NPC location|Drakkar Lake}} (one location)
** {{NPC location|Norrhart Domains}} (multiple possible locations)
** {{NPC location|Varajar Fells}} (multiple possible locations)

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Earth Shaker}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Flail}}
* {{skill icon|Irresistible Blow}}
* {{skill icon|Pulverizing Smash}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Jormungand's Thunder]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* Jormungand spawns alongside two [[Frost Wurm]]s.
* If the boss does not appear, a solitary [[Frozen Elemental]] or [[Frost Wurm]] will sometimes spawn instead.
** Some players believe that the appearance of these other foes at any potential spawning location means that Jormungand will not appear in the current [[instance]]. However, no one has published sufficient research to confirm or deny this theory.

== Trivia ==
* [[w:Jörmungandr|Jörmungandr]] is the world-circling serpent from Norse mythology. He is one of the three children of Loki, the Norse god of mischief, and is brother to [[w:Fenrir|Fenrir]] (see also: [[Fenrir]]) and [[w:Hel (being)|Hel]].
